items.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued October 30 at 12:24PM CDT by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.description:
A system will bring periods of gusty winds along with a good
chance of showers and a few thunderstorms over the Upper Texas
Coastal waters between Matagorda Bay and Galveston this afternoon.
Winds of 15-20 knots, with gusts up to 25 knots are expected. Near
or within any heavy shower or thunderstorm, winds could gust over
30 knots. A waterspout cannot be ruled out over the Gulf.

For the Gulf waters near Galveston, the bulk of the showers and
isolated thunderstorms may not arrive until this evening.
